steps.text: There is an old man in the audience.
This old man has not a speck of interest in competition knights. At the behest of his beloved grandchild, he has grudgingly purchased two tickets to the event so hyped up by the newspapers and media.
He frowns, he sighs, for he does not know why the crowd cheers for the public execution of the young Kuranta by the Sarkaz.
He does not think anything is wrong, for he too was once a knight, a campaign knight without a noble title. He merely scoffs at the competition, at the Sarkaz.
Yet, the battlefield suddenly flares with a blazing light. The old man remembers that the knight is the young lady of the Nearl family.
What a pity, he laments as he stares at the dazzling light. At the same time, the very few Kazimierz present in the audience simultaneously recall an old story.
The story takes place in a land beyond rivers, forests and lakes, in a great fortress formed of towers and walls.

Every day, as night falls, blazing torches form an unbroken line. The campaign knights' armor gleams beneath the moonlight, the sharp edges of their silver lances point at the restless enemy prowling in the darkness.
The invaders are ruthless. The Leithanians, capable of coloring the sky, black out the moon. The terrible armies of Ursus overwhelm the castle walls.
Cities are captured and brought into Ursus in humiliation. The lines fall back once and again, as 'Silverlance' becomes a mocking joke leveled at the knights by the warmongers.
They are pushed to the outskirts of the last city, the last line of defense——
——Where Kazimierz makes its last stand, a pegasus with golden hair appears.
On the dawn of that day, when the Ursus suffer their first defeat of the war, on the faraway horizon of Kazimierz, two suns rise.
Light.
The light does not dissipate. Rays of light diffuse into a haze, banishing the terror.
At this moment, even the sun itself nods, welcoming the returning knight.
...Maria.
Stand up, Maria.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ......Margaret?
Maria.
You've grown up. You've really done well.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: No... That's not Maria's Arts...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Mr. Czarny! We just received a message from——the Armorless Union! A beam of light crashed into the arena from a kilometer away northwest!

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: It was very, very fast! They couldn't even get a glimpse of what it was!

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: ...Terrorist attack?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: I-It doesn't seem like a weapon. It's a person, a Kuranta, but only the strongest knights are able to handle speed like that——

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Impossible... Light... Could it be...

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: Guh... Where's the enemy? Too bright, can't see...!

steps.name: Withered Knight
steps.text: Mission, must be completed. No matter who——kill the target first!

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: Knocked off my feet... barehanded...? Who?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Foul Arts and tortured Sarkaz Infected. Is this what a 'knight' should be?

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: Gaa...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret...?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Wait... Is it really you? I'm not hallucinating, am I...?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It's me.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: R... Really?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ......Margaret?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: You've done well, Maria.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: *Sob*... Margaret... What... What took you so long...?

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: ...Wretch! Kill them both!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: No, don't even think about it.

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: Why... Why can't I hit her...?

steps.name: Withered Knight
steps.text: ...Her light is gathering and suppressing our Arts. Retreat. I will deal with her.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: It's her——She came in that light. It's——that's——that's the Radiant Knight!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: What's going on?! The exiled Radiant Knight returns at the climax of this fight!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: (Hey! Go get the spokesman! What the hell is going on?! What——Huh?)

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Sh-She broke the rules! But that's not important! To save her sister, the Radiant Knight did whatever it took to return to Kazimierz!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Exceptional courage! Extraordinary demeanor! Unrelenting in the face of the two knights from hell!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Let us cheer——for the Radiant Knight!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: That's... Margaret? That knight with the shield is the Radiant Knight...?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: W-Why did she come back to Kazimierz...?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: I don't even recognize her anymore...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: ...It's her. What has she been through all these years...?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: The Radiant Knight, that spirited Margaret... She's returned?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Huff...... Just be a dear and let us through.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Sorry. No can do.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: So we gotta put our lives on the line then, eh?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I'd really rather you didn't.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I'll say it again: there's nothing you can do. I live by a rule, I don't fight with anyone but my target.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: As long as you stay away from the arena, you get to live——Hm?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ——It's getting bright?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Hey! V, look over there!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: What...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: That light... that...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Old Man Nearl...?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: (This is a lot more intense than Maria's Arts. Could it be...?)

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: (But... The two Lazurites... It can't be...)

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: It's me.
Time to stop playing, little pegasus. Pack up and skedaddle.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...What?
The Radiant Knight herself is in the mix. No point to guarding the door anymore, is there?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I think I get the gist of it... But you still failed, even with the both of you?
Don't be so suspicious of your superiors, little pegasus. The board of directors only asked us to 'watch the Radiant Knight' after all, not fight her...
I was thinking that even if we did fight, I would have that dumb-faced idiot with me so it wouldn't be any problem at all.

Turns out there was, uh, a tiny issue shall we say. First off, the Radiant Knight seems to have gotten just that little bit stronger... There are also some troublesome horns together with her, it's really annoying.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Well... If it's even giving you trouble, you're wasting your time telling me about it.
Oh, I almost forgot. I wanted to tell you about it because the target is approaching your location right now——Hmm, might be too late, actually.
Well, try to avoid fighting at all costs. Good luck surviving, little Platinum.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Sorry? Wait...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: What the hell are they doing...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Could it be Młynar? No, can't be... He should still be in his office... Then...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Nnh...!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: (Wh-what? Just now, was that...a blue shadow?)

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: I know!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: What's happening? I've never felt like this before...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...Don't move. Breathe slowly and look around.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: (Feels like I've been made... And those two are looking jumpy...)

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Oh, here.
A white-horned Sarkaz holding a sword stops in front of them. She breathes softly, raising her eyes at them.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ......Ugh, of course they'd be difficult to handle... They're not even knights...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Let them pass. Their names aren't on the list anyway.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: ...Thank you.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Liz, can you still move?

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Yes... It's bright over there.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: It's Nearl.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Let us go then?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...Really, what's going on today...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: That Sarkaz just now... Does she know Margaret? What's happening?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: It's really Margaret! V! Margaret's back!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...Don't yell.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Then... What about us? Do we keep going?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Don't stare at me like that... You get to live.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: They cancelled the mission. I don't have a reason to stop you anymore.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You get to live.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You gonna leave, just like that? Halt!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: V! Don't bother with them, let's get to the arena!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Tch...damned Armorless Union.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Margaret Nearl... The Radiant Knight!

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Where's the arena security?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: S-Security...? That was the Radiant Knight charging at full power, we'd probably have to raise the city's barrier to stop her...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Radiant Knight...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Haha... Radiant Knight... With things as they are now, why did you even return? To look at the knights' epitaph?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Mr. Czarny! We've received word from the General Chamber of Commerce... You...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Mr. Malkiewicz.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: No matter what happens next, even if I don't return, you must not leave this room.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: O-Okay...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Yes, I've already prepared everything beforehand... Yes, Czarny, you have already done everything you could, so just wait for the curtain call.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: How amusing... Pfft, hahaha...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Sir...?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Ah, excuse me...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Mr. Czarny? Your phone...?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: ...I know, I know.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Please excuse me... for a moment.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...Knight techniques.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But drug overdose and signs of overreliance on Arts. Also...

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: Guh——

steps.name: Withered Knight
steps.text: I will suppress her! Kill the target!
The mentally crippled Sarkaz warrior brandishes his weapon, Arts and the smell of a grave.
But the Radiant Knight does not move.

steps.name: Withered Knight
steps.text: ——Kill her!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Hmm, the explosive energy has been dissipated——

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: ——Die!

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: Guh....! You...still have strength?!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Maria, your wounds——

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret! You once said a knight raises her shield to protect others... right?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But, now, on this battlefield——

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ——There is no one that you need to protect!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I will become your shield, so——

steps.name: Withered Knight
steps.text: Move aside, I will blast them both to death!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ——I'll do my best!

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: Guh... She abandoned her shield! But your Arts!

steps.name: Withered Knight
steps.text: ...This, impossible... That warhammer is her staff, she...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Are you ready, Maria?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: To be a knight...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Is to be the noble light that illuminates the land!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The Radiant Knight who charged onto the field has abandoned her shield after just a few short exchanges! Hold on! Wait!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Remember the two-handed warhammer craze that followed the Radiant Knight?! Watch her swing that hammer, her shield long forgotten! This is the old school Radiant Knight!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: She's out there, against all odds! The return of the legend! The National Council could drag her away right after this match. This could be our only chance to witness the glory of the Radiant Knight!

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: This... these Arts, this glow...

steps.name: Left-hand Knight
steps.text: Why are you allowed to give off that kind of light so impassively...? You arrogant little——Do you really think yourself the sun?! Radiant Knight!

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: How long has it been since we saw Margaret put her shield down?

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Her light... It's hot.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: She will be fine, right?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I've never seen her fail, after looking like that.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: The girl is a lot like Nearl.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Yes, that's her sister.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Hehe... What a cute little knight. I can see the resemblance.

steps.name: Withered Knight
steps.text: ...Arrows... ran out!

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: Gaa——! Your Arts!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: He's forming arrows using his Arts... I'll block them!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Leave the rest to me.

steps.name: Withered Knight
steps.text: Can't penetrate——this damned light!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: ...The audience is quiet.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Margaret doesn't have an advantage. Those two Sarkaz are strong... and work well together.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: But I don't feel like Margaret will lose... I don't even think she is disadvantaged...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Her techniques are mesmerizing... Her demeanor is so calm, yet her light burns so brightly...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: It reminds me of Old Nearl, when he was young.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Un-unbelievable! Totally unbelievable!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The radiance from every swing of Margaret's warhammer completely dispels her opponent's Arts! Even the cracks the Radiant Knight steps on are filled with light!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: What amazingly brilliant Arts! Combat techniques of this level!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: This is definitely befitting of a champion! The true strength of a knight——!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Haa... My wounds aren't hurting as much anymore... Is this Margaret's Arts too?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (Caring about me even during a battle like this——)

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: Gaa——! My hammer...!

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: No weapon, then, with my hands, I'll tear you apart——!

steps.name: Withered Knight
steps.text: Kill her!
Margaret has a strange expression on her face. It's...pity?
For these two Sarkaz? Because they are called knights? Or is it... because of their circumstances?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...Maria.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ah, I'm here!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I'll leave the support to you.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ——Yes!

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: Do it!

steps.name: Withered Knight
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Repent.
At this moment, the entire arena descends into silence.
No one has realized that the match has ended. There aren't any knights boasting about their victory, nor are there the defiant howls of the losers.
The corrupted Sarkaz kneel on the ground——They have not fallen over, and the Radiant Knight does not strike.
She looks down upon the two Sarkaz, then takes a knee and extends her hand.
There is no reply from the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: You should not give up on your destiny.

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: No...
As if unwilling to bow to the two young girls, they remain silent, unable to stand.
The Radiant Knight turns.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Maria.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Eh? What...?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: We've won.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: This is unbelievable! Can you believe your eyes?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Because I sure can't! The Radiant Knight who suddenly entered the fight! The Knights Association that let it happen! Oh my god, I, this——

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: I've never seen a situation like this in all my years of commentating! Though I don't know how the National Council will react, it doesn't change the fact that they won!

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: (Mr. Mob.)

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: (...Oh, you're here!)

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: I am deeply honored to announce to everyone!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: (Mr. Spokesman, what should I do?)

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: (Acknowledge her.)

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The winner is! The young and miraculous Maria! Aaaand, she who has returned from her long exile, the pegasus that everyone knows, the Radiant Knight! Margareeeeeeeeet Neaaaaaaaaarl!

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: (That's right, Mr. Mob. I really do appreciate your ability to fan the fervor of the audience.)

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: (Hold the fort for a while, someone will come to handle this.)

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Cheer for her——!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Zofia?! Where are you going?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Marcin! Where are they——Ugh, that, that one?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Is it really Margaret... Why'd Margaret come back now?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: N-no matter what, she's an exile. Why didn't she tell us——

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Alright, both of you calm down. Młynar might have known about this... But for now, we need to leave.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: The reporters and the crowd are going to swarm this place. We have to find a way——to get the Radiant Knight home.

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Radiant Knight! That's the Radiant Knight from last season!

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Make way, make way! Let me get a picture!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Everyone! Everybody! Please remain calm! No matter what happened, we have to make sure that the competition adheres to the proper procedures all the way up to the end!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: (What should I do next?! You can't contact the spokesman?! Idiot! Go look for him at the VIP seats——!)

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Hold on! That, that's the Whislash Knight! The Whislash Knight suddenly rushed towards the Radiant Knight from the crowd——

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Zof——

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Eh——A-Aunt Zofia?!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You... Why are you back?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: ——D-did she just slap the Radiant Knight? Huh? Eh? This looks like it'll be in the papers tomorrow——

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I'm sorry. But I've returned.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...That slap was for Maria.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I'll spare you my own.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Thanks for sparing me... But, you used your right hand just now... When did that happen?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Now isn't the time to talk about that. The National Council will definitely not allow an exile to return to Kazimierz.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: We have to leave before the reporters and the National Council show up.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: R-right now? But the competition results haven't...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: It doesn't matter! She's here and that's way more important than the competition!

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Nearl.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Careful, Liz!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...You don't need to worry so much. Alright, hold my hand tight.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: These two Sarkaz...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Don't worry, they're my friends. Shining, can you do me a favor?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: I... I fainted... These are healing Arts?

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: Who... you?!

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: Sarkaz, you... you! It can't be, you? Healed me?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Your injuries are very serious, but they are not from this match. The scars of drug usage may never be removed. You should take better care of yourselves.

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: Go away——Don't touch me! Guh...

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: Wait... You...you are...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: ——Nearl.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Yeah, I know.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Those two assassins from the Armorless Union are still watching us... Now is not the time to celebrate.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: A-Armorless Union? You——

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Time to run? Nearl?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ——No.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: A victorious knight has no reason to scurry away like a coward. If they wish to stop us, just let them try.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Nearl, over there.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Ah... It's Mr. Kowal and Mr. Vogelweide. Have they found something?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: What do you think?! Of course they're preparing a way for you to escape!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: The three of us will help keep the crowds away from you, but the National Council will definitely be paying you a visit. You'll have to deal with them yourself——

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ——Margaret!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Yeah?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: It's really great... that you came back.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: The usual place, don't be late.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: That's... Nearl's family?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: She's come back home. We can all see her joy, no?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: So, let's give her some space. She's the Radiant Knight after all. No one in Kazimierz can touch her.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: We'll regroup with Amiya later.
Margaret raises her head.
She used to hate this land with every fiber of her being.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...Maria.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ah, yes?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...Let's go home.
But this is her home.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...You're here. What about your little follower?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: ...He's the next one.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Ah... How cruel.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Just tell me the answer.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Well, aren't you straightforward...? You already know the answer, why ask me?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Maybe you can live better.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: No... Maybe I will die on the way to my exile. Maybe you will be the one to do it.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...Maybe. Don't blame me, if I am.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: It won't happen through the National Council. You'll have to leave by tonight. Is there anything you need to take care of?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Szewczyk has a young son. He was present during the incident.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: I wish to ask you...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: ...To make sure that he never has a chance to speak the truth.
